The override is `if (milestone.type) activityType = milestone.type;` (:1540) and `matchMilestone` forwards `type` only when it is a string (:660). So an unset `type` leaves `updated`, and a milestone can fire only on an update — both halves of the new text. Any other path? None: the only runtime consumer of `activityMilestones` at the head is this file (the other hits are the form, the four generated form-locale bundles, lint's docblock, spec baselines and docs), there is no bulk or upsert arm in `actionFor`, and no other `sys_activity` writer reads milestones.
